name: io.github.Spacemandomains/mcp-registry-search
title: MCP Registry Search
description: Search and browse every MCP server in the Model Context Protocol registry.

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: Browse all MCP servers in the official MCP registry with pagination. Supports latest_only (boolean) and limit (1-100, default 20).

latest_only.description: Only return latest version of each server

tools.name: get_mcp_server_details
tools.description: Get full metadata, endpoints, auth requirements, and tools for any MCP server by its reverse-DNS registry name.

tools.name: search_mcp_registry
tools.description: Search MCP servers by plain name or keyword. Returns matching servers from the official registry without needing to know the exact reverse-DNS identifier.

query.description: Plain text search query (e.g. hawaii, crypto trading, job search)

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default 10, max 50)
